figures.notes: Width-bias/limit panel: every m<=0.30 cell exceeds its limit (ratios 1.66-9.69, bold), all eight blue-framed gated cells fail (ratios 4.63-8.33), m=1.00 row all under limit (0.34-0.54). Coverage panel shows w=3 over-coverage at m=0.15/0.17 (0.95/0.98). m-bias panel violated only in the w=3 column at low m. Matches the aggregate verdict cell-for-cell.

Low-m rows are bimodal pileups at the fit-window bounds (~0.003 and 0.25 MHz) rather than at truth; the pileup weakens with rising m and vanishes at m=1.00, where all four widths concentrate tightly on truth. Confirms the failure is SNR-driven fit collapse, not a bookkeeping error.

Four of 24 null realizations (both held-out off-pulse and pairing-scramble kinds) exceed the family-wise threshold 4.408, max 4.810; one fail-closed fit-level detection (bound-clear control fit with invalid uncertainty now counts as a detection under the hardened rule). Fail-closed null gate correctly reports FAIL.
